main_text.l: AN alteri ἀντεξηγήσει Gronovii de Fœnore Vnciaro respondere deberem, diu mecum deliberavi, licet admodum in proclivi esset. Dissuadebant amici, & quidem multis de causis. Primo meam sententi-am

page.notes: The left-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page with fragments of marginal text (e.g. "STEIN,", "denburg", "Camerae", "MO", "Schoockii"); these are largely cut off and not transcribed. Line "Primo meam sententi-" ends the page; the final word "am" at the foot is read as the signature of the gathering, and the printed hyphen-break in "sententi-am" is uncertain. Some words in the body are partly obscured by show-through from the reverse side, e.g. "Dissuadebant" and "quidem".
